The '''''Arak''-series probe droid''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]]. The miners of [[Banvhar Station]] used three of them in a failed [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. 

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] employed ''Arak''-series droids during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
